subject: gk
question: In November 2022, the Supreme Court upheld the validity of the 103 constitutional amendment providing ______ per cent reservation to people belonging to economically weaker section (EWS).
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **103rd Constitution Amendment 2019**, which provides for** 10% EWS reservation** among the advanced castes, was maintained by the **Supreme Court on Monday, November 7, 2022, by a 3-2 majority.**
 
• The decision was made by a **five-judge panel **that included **Chief Justice of India (CJI) UU Lalit, Justices Dinesh Maheshwari, S Ravindra Bhat, Bela M Trivedi, and JB Pardiwala.**
 
• There were three concurring rulings and one dissenting ruling by** Justice Ravindra Bhat.** CJI Lalit declared that he wholeheartedly concurred with Bhat's viewpoint.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supreme Court**

 
 
• ​According to the **constitution**, the** Supreme Court of India** is both the highest court in the **Republic of India** and the country's top** judicial authority.**
 
• It has the final say in all legal matters and is the** highest constitutional court**. Also, it is capable of **judicial scrutiny**.
 
• The** Supreme Court of India**, which has a maximum of **34 judges and the Chief Justice of India** as its head, has a wide range of authority in the form of **original, appellate, and advisory jurisdictions.**
